description: Lead a team of **3 engineers** and own frontend architecture across **3 microservices** of a HIPAA-compliant telemedicine and biometric-assessment platform used by **1,000+ patients and clinicians**. Replaced fragile React-hook state with a deterministic **finite-state-machine** engine, so **99.9%** of assessment sessions complete without a crash or freeze, with **60 FPS** MediaPipe pose estimation and real-time rep counting. Built a **Konva.js** canvas engine for clinicians to correct range-of-motion measurements, moved MediaRecorder to imperative control to remove lifecycle bugs and memory leaks, led the **Redux Toolkit** rewrite of the medical-assessment chatbot, and refactored **54+ modules** into a presentational/container architecture. Introduced the team code-review process and mentor 3 engineers.

registeredContribution.description: Named co-author of MyMedicalHUB’s AI & machine-learning musculoskeletal assessment software, registered with the Bangladesh Copyright Office on 15 September 2024.

description: Owned the biometric strength-assessment module end to end and led cloud cost and infrastructure work across **4 environments**. Cut cloud hosting cost **70%** (about **$10K a year**) by moving from self-managed VMs to **Azure App Service** with GitHub Actions CI/CD, and improved application performance **40%** to **Lighthouse 90+** by replacing 5 legacy UI libraries. Designed a **feature-flag system** and API-driven theming that serve **250+ client configurations** from one codebase, and shipped **HIPAA-compliant SSO**, an automated clinical reporting engine and a session-recording pipeline to AWS S3. Named Employee of the Month in October 2023.

Built the real-time video consultation layer of a telemedicine platform for remote physical therapy. Added real-time AI analysis and joint-angle measurement to live sessions, making assessments **25% faster** than manual measurement with **95%+ accuracy** against expert clinicians. Replaced the third-party OpenTok service with a **WebRTC** pipeline on self-hosted STUN/TURN servers and Socket.IO, turning a usage-based bill (about **$3K a year**) into a fixed cost and reducing latency and dropped calls. Built the first canvas annotation tool, a **JWT-based API client** with XSS and CSRF protection, and CI/CD across 4 environments.

Frontend intern on a telemedicine platform and my first production React work. Built **responsive React components** used across desktop and mobile, fixed front-end performance and stability issues to **reduce page load time**, and delivered features in an Agile team with sprints, code review, documentation and Git.

Kept **IT systems running** for a rehabilitation and training centre, handling software updates, hardware maintenance and troubleshooting. Maintained program and **student-progress data** used for assessments and organisational reporting.

Designed and taught a **computer-skills curriculum** (IT fundamentals, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for around **25 students**, tracking each student with hands-on assessments. Early practice in explaining technical topics simply, which I now use when mentoring engineers.

Built and maintained websites and web applications for **2 client projects** using **PHP, JavaScript and MySQL**. Turned client requirements into scoped features, and wrote and ran **test scenarios** before each release.

summary: Developed **messaging backend features** for a customer lifecycle management platform, including **Meta integrations**, conversation automation and routing, **WhatsApp coexistence**, and real-time inbox events.
description: Contributed to the **CLM API messaging backend** with **WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram integrations**. Implemented inbound event handling and deduplication, **keyword-based automation**, and agent assignment by skill, department, and priority. Added **durable WhatsApp coexistence storage**, history synchronization, quoted replies, and **conversation SLA timers**. Implemented presence and typing events with **conversation access checks**, and added **unit and end-to-end test coverage**. The available repository records **47 authored commits from 28 May to 10 June 2026 (UTC+6)**; these dates describe the verified contribution window rather than contractual employment dates.

summary: Built the **shared API foundation** for an MCQ learning platform, with **versioned Express routes**, request protection, email error notifications, and deployment configuration. Learning-domain operations remain scaffold implementations.
description: Organized questions, exams, courses, enrolment, and results into **versioned Express modules** for an MCQ learning platform. Centralized **controller wrappers, response formatting, and error handling** to give new features a consistent API structure. Added Helmet security headers, request limits, timeouts, and rate limiting at the application boundary. Included **Nodemailer error notifications** and **Docker/PM2 deployment configuration**. The reviewed implementation establishes API infrastructure; persisted learning workflows, exam execution, and result storage remain incomplete.

summary: Built **school information interfaces**, **Google Drive admission-document storage**, and survey APIs with separate definitions, templates, and completed records. Co-developed a **PHP/MariaDB catalog and administration project**.
description: Built **Next.js and React school pages** for admissions, notices, routines, results, staff, and galleries, with responsive navigation, Swiper galleries, and a Google Maps integration. The frontend uses local sample content and an in-memory admin demonstration. In the school backend, implemented **Google Drive file handling** and stored admission-document identifiers and links in MongoDB. Separated controllers, persistence services, and **Joi input validation**. Built **Mongoose survey CRUD services**, keeping survey definitions, reusable templates, and completed school/location records separate. Co-developed TechnoFire's **PHP, MySQLi, and MariaDB** catalog and administration codebase with Abid Hasan Piash; individual ownership of its features is not established. These repositories document prototypes and implementation scope, not verified production deployment.

summary: Built **React inventory workflows** with **Firebase Authentication**, stock-update and delivery requests, and user-specific item views. Implemented a separate **Express/MongoDB inventory API** for products and supporting business records.
description: Built **inventory browsing and item-management interfaces** with React, React Router, and Tailwind CSS. Integrated **Firebase Authentication**, shared sign-in helpers, and an email/token request flow, using **Axios** for stock updates, delivery actions, and user-specific item requests. POSDash depends on its own companion server; it is not the client for the separately documented inventory API. In that **Express and MongoDB backend**, implemented product reads, creates, updates, and deletes, with pharmacy and non-pharmacy resource routes. Organized orders, returns, suppliers, customers, and employees into dedicated endpoints. The reviewed legacy source contains incomplete and miswired routes, so the portfolio describes implemented components without claiming complete end-to-end operation.
